issue.title: Find what sets the D 61 M 48 residual floor with the cut: raise the cut

labels.name: macm3
labels.description: Task for macm3, the M3 Mac laptop

milestone.title: G4 · Digits and error bars

issue.body:
**What.** Find what sets #70 job 6's residual floor at D 61.03, M 48 with the cut. It stops at |F| = 2.7e-15 above the 1e-15 gate, with Newton and LM not lowering it, as the cloud found in October. The cut floors grow with D: 8e-28 at D 30, 2.0e-18 at D 45, 2.7e-15 at D 61. The same seed converges to 3.8e-23 at M 32. Recommended by macm3 in #70's summary.

**Hypotheses, fixed before the runs.**
- (a) The double-double rounding floor of the residual. That is unlikely, since M 32 reaches 3.8e-23 at the same D.
- (b) The cut itself. At M 48 the cut kf 13 freezes harmonics 13–23, against 13–15 at M 32. The frozen harmonics' violation of the equations would be a floor that grows with D.

**Commands (macm3, 1 thread, nice 10; raw folder `I159-macm3/`).** The same job 6 line with `--kf=17` and then `--kf=21`, `--tag=D61.0264_M48_kf17` and `_kf21`, `--data=../choptuik-large-d-raw/I159-macm3/data`. Report the setup |F| after LM for each. If one converges below 1e-15, let it count, under #70's stop rules.

**Reading.** If |F| falls as the cut rises, (b) holds. If it stays at 2.7e-15 for every cut, (a) or another floor; a higher-precision residual at M 48 is then the next step, which the kernel lacks (the octo residual is M = 32 only).

**Depends on.** #70.

comments.body: started: macm3, main checkout at e04d6f17, venv-macm3 (python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0, hpkernel 0.1.0 neon), job 6's line at M 48 with `--kf=17` and `--kf=21` (tags `D61.0264_M48_kf17`, `_kf21`, `--data=../choptuik-large-d-raw/I159-macm3/data`), 1 thread each, nice 10, caffeinate -is, 09:45 UTC, run side by side with each other and with #160 since they are independent. Neither has a saved state in hp/data, so each projects the M 32 seed to M 48 with its cut and re-converges. If one converges below 1e-15 after LM it counts, under #70's stop rules. The hypotheses and the reading are the ones in the issue body.

**Interim (macm3, 09:57 UTC): the setup |F| after Levenberg-Marquardt falls as the cut rises, which is the reading of the issue for hypothesis (b). kf 21 converged and is counting.**

| cut | M 48 frozen harmonics | \|F\| in the layout | after Newton | after Levenberg-Marquardt | setup | wall |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| kf 13 (#70 job 6) | 13 to 23 | 2.7e-15 | 2.7e-15 | **2.7e-15** | raised, gate 1e-15 | 401 s |
| kf 17 | 17 to 23 | 1.3e-06 | 9.3e-07 | **1.4e-15** | raised, 1.4e-15 > 1e-15 | 708 s |
| kf 21 | 21 to 23 | 1.3e-06 | 1.3e-06 | **1.3e-19** | passed | counting since 09:53 UTC |

The kf 17 run did not get below the gate (1.4e-15 against 1e-15), so it stops and does not count. kf 21 is 4 orders below, and its count (about 80 determinants, roughly 40 minutes) is running. The same M 32 seed, projected to M 48, starts at 1.3e-06 for both cuts. Awake time equals wall time so far (no sleep). The summary follows the count, with the boxes and the files.

**Correction to my interim comment (macm3, 09:58 UTC).** The column "M 48 frozen harmonics" (13 to 23, 17 to 23, 21 to 23) is not from the code. I extended the 13 to 23 of the issue body by a guess. What `plow_odd(M, kf)` in `hp/python/hpkernel/driver.py` does is project an odd field on the half grid onto the odd harmonics k <= kf. At M 48 the odd harmonics are k = 1, 3, ..., 47, so 24 of them, and at M 32, 16 (k up to 31). The cut keeps:

| M | odd harmonics in all | kf 13 keeps | kf 17 keeps | kf 21 keeps |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 32 | 16 | 7 (44%) | | |
| 48 | 24 | 7 (29%) | 9 (38%) | 11 (46%) |

So at M 48 the cut kf 13 freezes 17 of 24 odd harmonics (71%), against 9 of 16 (56%) at M 32. That is in the direction of hypothesis (b), and kf 21 keeps 46% at M 48, close to the 44% that kf 13 keeps at M 32. The numbers in the issue body (13 to 23 at M 48, 13 to 15 at M 32) are another count of harmonics, and I could not match them to `plow_odd`. The |F| results of the interim table are unaffected. This replaces the column in the final summary.

**Status of the kf 21 count (macm3, 12:21 UTC, read only, nothing changed): it is progressing, no stall. It needs far more determinants than the other M 48 counts because the phase of g winds quickly along its edges.**

| item | value |
|---|---|
| process | alive, 2 h 34 min since 09:45:35 UTC, 100% cpu, 204 MB |
| evaluations done | **327** (the cache's last write was 12:19:22 UTC) |
| time per determinant | mean 26.8 s, median 26.5 s, range 26.0 to 35.8 s, falling from 35 s to 26.5 s as the run warmed up; none above 40 s, no pause between evaluations |
| sleep | none: the determinant times are steady, 8777 s of the 9238 s elapsed are determinants and the rest is the 8-minute re-convergence, and `pmset` records no sleep since 22:39 PST yesterday |
| edges done | 11 of 14; left: `Re=aLL, Im y1->y2`, `Im=y2, Re aR->aL`, `Im=y2, Re aL->aLL` |

**Why it is longer.** The count adds points until every phase step of g is at most about 0.39 rad, so the number of points follows the phase change of g along each edge. At kf 21 those phase changes are much larger than in the counts that finished:

| edge | D 45 M 48 kf 13 (#70) | D 61 M 32 kf 13 (#160), points | D 61 M 48 kf 21, points |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Re=aR, Im 0->y1` | -0.14 rad | -0.16 rad, 4 | **-7.79 rad, 25** |
| `Re=aL, Im 0->y1` | -0.19 rad | -0.23 rad, 4 | **-5.31 rad, 23** |
| `Im=y1, Re aR->a2` | +0.25 rad | +0.29 rad, 8 | **+15.75 rad, 57** |
| `Re=aR, Im y1->y2` | -0.38 rad | -0.35 rad, 7 | **-15.58 rad, 49** |
| `Re=aL, Im y1->y2` | +2.12 rad | +2.26 rad, 10 | **-13.89 rad, 52** |
| ln\|g\| range on `Re=aR, Im y1->y2` | | 0.03 to 0.63 | **1.57 to 29.69** |

The other two counts have phase changes of at most about 3 rad per edge and ln|g| within about 1.5, so they need 80 to 86 determinants. This one has 25 to 57 points on each long edge and ln|g| up to 29.7. On the edges from Im 0 to y1 the phase changes by 4.5 rad per unit of Im, so g still carries a growth that the real-axis trend does not remove. Whether that is only the trend fit missing a complex part, or extra structure of det M at kf 21 (more harmonics are kept than at kf 13), I cannot tell from the edges. The winding of each box is printed at the end, and a wind(g) not 0 in any box is the finding that stops the run.

**Estimate, with the error bar of a guess.** The three edges left are probably as dense as their counterparts: `Re=aLL, Im y1->y2` about 50 points, `Im=y2, Re aR->aL` about 85 to 120 (the `Im=y1` edges had 57, 25 and 3), `Im=y2, Re aL->aLL` about 5. So about 150 to 180 more determinants, or 70 to 80 more minutes at 27 s: the count would end between 13:30 and 14:00 UTC, with 480 to 510 evaluations in all. I will post the boxes when it ends.

Raw so far, `I159-macm3/` (log `job6_kf21.log`, cache `data/modecount_D61.0264_M48_kf21_evals.jsonl`).

**Memory guards on macm3 (macm3, 13:32 UTC), as Nathan's instruction relayed by the coordinator asks: none running; the kf 21 count was not touched.**

- Running now: only the kf 21 count (`caffeinate -is nice -n 10 python3 hp/modecount_wind.py ...`), with no wrapper, timeout or memory rule around it.
- No cron job, no launch agent of mine, no watcher, no `comms_watch.py`.
- The only memory-based stop rule I ever ran was `t142.py`'s stop at swap above 2048 MB (T142, 2026-11-07), a runner script in a scratch folder that ended with that task. T146 to T149 had only time caps. Since #37 no run of mine has had any memory rule.
- The repository has one, which I do not use and which is not running here: `util_report.py --guard MIN_FREE_GB --log FILE PID...` kills the process trees of the given PIDs when free memory falls below the threshold (its docstring says it is for runs that are allowed to die). It is the coordinator's to keep or remove.
- Things I cannot see or change from here: macOS itself, and whether the Claude Code harness on this Mac stops background shells under memory pressure (win reported it did on its machine, on 2026-11-07). Nothing like that has happened to a macm3 run.

**Summary (macm3).** Hypothesis (b) holds on the residual: raising the cut lowers the setup |F| after Levenberg-Marquardt from 2.7e-15 (kf 13) to 1.4e-15 (kf 17) to 1.3e-19 (kf 21), and kf 21 converges and counts. But the count is a finding: **wind(g) is not 0 in three of the six boxes that resolved, with six zeros of det M beyond the expected ones**, and one edge did not resolve, so two boxes are not counts.

**The cuts** (D 61.03, M 48, the same seed, `--data=<raw>/I159-macm3/data`, 1 thread, nice 10, awake time equal to wall time):

| cut | odd harmonics kept of 24 | \|F\| in the layout | after Newton | after Levenberg-Marquardt | setup | wall |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| kf 13 (#70 job 6, resumed; October's cloud run from scratch also ends here) | 7 (29%) | 2.7e-15 | 2.7e-15 | **2.7e-15** | raised | 401 s |
| kf 17 | 9 (38%) | 1.3e-06 | 9.3e-07 | **1.4e-15** | raised, above the gate | 708 s |
| kf 21 | 11 (46%) | 1.3e-06 | 1.3e-06 | **1.3e-19** | passed, then counted | 19277 s (5.35 h) |

The reading fixed in the issue was that |F| falling as the cut rises supports (b), and it does, by 4 orders from kf 13 to kf 21. kf 17 sits at 1.4e-15, just above the gate. (The harmonic counts are from `plow_odd`, as corrected on this issue.)

**The kf 21 count** (707 new determinants, 26.6 s each):

| box | B0 | U0 | B1a | B1b | B1c | B1 | U | full |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| expected zeros inside | 1 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 2 | 0 | 2 |
| candidate poles inside | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 7 | 14 |
| **winding of g** | 0 | 0 | 0 | **+4** | **+2** | **+6** | +9 | +24 |
| winding of det M | 1 | 0 | 1 | 5 | 2 | 8 | 2 | 12 |
| resolved | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | **no** | **no** |

- **The finding.** B1b has 4 zeros of det M beyond its expected one, B1c has 2, and B1 has 6 (the sum, 0 + 4 + 2), all with 1.269 < Re λ < 6.585 and |Im λ| < 1.738 (the strip around the real axis). Every phase step of the resolved edges is at most 0.39 rad and their verification has 0 mismatches. In the kf 13 counts at D 45 (M 48) and D 61 (M 32), and at D 16.76, 8.25 and 30, wind(g) is 0 everywhere.
- **The unresolved edge.** `Im=y2, Re aR->aL` took 350 points for a phase change of +79.6 rad and ended with "verified 183 (mismatch 9) in 4 passes", so U and full are printed "UNRESOLVED: not a count". Their +9 and +24 mean nothing. This edge alone took about half the evaluations, which is why my 12:20 estimate (480 to 510 evaluations, done by 14:00) was too low: the run ended at 707 evaluations and 15:06.
- **Why g winds.** On every long edge the phase of g changes by 5 to 16 rad (the kf 13 counts have at most 3), ln|g| reaches 29 to 34, and g carries a growth the real-axis trend does not remove. That is the signature of the same thing that produced the zeros.

**What I can and cannot say about the zeros.** I did not locate them or test them at another resolution. The notes' reading of the D 30 extra pair (notes/MODE_COUNT.md, section 5) is the closest thing on record: with a cut at 13 the centre harmonics above it are pinned, they are the weak ("junk") directions with singular values falling like e^-0.7k, the cut is what lets the background converge, and without it det M picks up a zero there. That mechanism fits all of this run: the cut at 21 un-pins harmonics 15 to 21, |F| falls (the pinned harmonics no longer violate the equations), and extra zeros return. It would also say that the |F| floor of kf 13 at D 61 is the price of the pin, and that the count is only meaningful with the pin. That is a reading from the notes, not a result of this run, and the notes also say that a genuine fast mode and an artifact cannot be separated by the cut alone.

**Acceptance (#159).**

| criterion | verdict |
|---|---|
| \|F\| after Levenberg-Marquardt for kf 17 and kf 21 | met: 1.4e-15 and 1.3e-19 |
| the reading: \|F\| falling as the cut rises supports (b) | met, it falls by 4 orders |
| if one converges below 1e-15 it counts, under #70's stop rules | kf 21 counted, and wind(g) not 0 in B1b, B1c and B1 is a finding, reported here |

Raw, choptuik-large-d-raw `I159-macm3/` at 6646980 (pushed through d6f717f), with both logs, `.cmd` files, exits, `awake.log`, the 707-line cache in `data/`, `hp_data_after_kf17/` and `hp_data_after_kf21/`. `raw_check.py` over them exits 0. `hp/data` is clean: the two new states were copied and moved out. Main e04d6f17, venv-macm3 (python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0, hpkernel 0.1.0 neon). No memory guard or killing rule was ever on this run (noted above).

### Recommended tasks

**1. The D 61 count at M 32 with kf 21**
- What, `modecount_wind.py up23_D61.0264.npz --M=32 --kf=21 --h0=0.6 --lam=2.043532530673195 --fmax=1e-15 --tag=D61.0264_M32_kf21 --data=<raw>/...`, as #160 but with the higher cut (the M 32 seed converges, so about 16 minutes if the edges stay flat).
- Why, it says whether the six zeros come from un-pinning harmonics 15 to 21 (then they appear at M 32 too) or only at M 48.
- Acceptance (can fail), the winding of g in B1b, B1c and B1 is reported next to #160's zeros at kf 13. Extra zeros at kf 21 and none at kf 13 put the cause on the cut, none at M 32 put it on M 48.
- Depends on #159 and #160.

**2. Locate the six zeros**
- What, `hp/modecount_moment.py` on the kf 21 cache (the first moment of the argument principle over B1b and B1c), then a circle at each position (`modecount_circle.py`).
- Why, `modecount_local.sh` says to locate a finding before reporting it further.
- Acceptance (can fail), each zero has a position with Re > 0, and whether the real axis or conjugate pairs hold them is stated.
- Depends on #159.

**3. Resolve `Im=y2, Re aR->aL`**
- What, rerun that edge with the verification given more passes or a looser tolerance (the passes are a limit in the script, 4 here, and `--tol` and `--hmin` are options), to settle U and full.
- Why, U and full are not counts, and they hold the poles' side of the strip.
- Acceptance (can fail), the edge reads "resolved", or it is reported why not.
- Depends on #159.

$STATS

**Small correction to my summary (macm3, 15:10 UTC).** I wrote that wind(g) is 0 everywhere "in the kf 13 counts at D 45 (M 48) and D 61 (M 32), and at D 16.76, 8.25 and 30". Exactly: with the cut at 13, wind(g) is 0 in all 8 boxes at D 45 (M 48, #70), D 61 (M 32, #160) and D 30 (M 48, #148); at D 16.76 and 8.25 (M 32, #69) it is 0 without a cut, since the cut is applied by default only from D = 35; and at D 30, M 48 **without** the cut the circle finds the one extra pair of #68. The finding of this issue is the first case of extra zeros in a count with a cut above the production one.
